checked_items.item: RECOM R12P21503D barrier rating (agent: '6.4 kVDC series; reinforced working voltage not found; human review')
checked_items.evidence: Primary: RECOM RxxP2xx series datasheet REV 9-2024 (https://recom-power.com/pdf/Econoline/RxxP2xx.pdf, extracted text): 'Isolation Voltage I/P to O/P tested for 1 second 6.4kVDC, rated for 1 minute 3.2kVAC/60Hz, working voltage 250VACrms', 'Isolation Capacitance 1.5pF min. / 10pF max.', 'Insulation Grade according to 62368-1: basic'; certifications IEC/UL/CSA 62368-1 and 60950-1 (ITE standards, not 61800-5-1/62477-1). The datasheet lists only symmetric R05/R12P2xxS/D variants; R12P21503D is not in it (DigiKey lists it under 'RxxP2xxyyD Series', active, SIP-7, +15 V/-3 V, 6.4 kVDC: https://www.digikey.ie/en/products/detail/recom-power/R12P21503D/7354331). Correction: the family's published insulation grade is BASIC with a 250 VACrms working voltage, i.e. below the 440 VDC reinforced requirement; this is a stronger finding than 'not found' and must block the module from the reinforced barrier role until the yyD datasheet proves otherwise.
checked_items.correction: Treat the R12P2 family as basic-insulation / 250 VACrms per its series datasheet; a module for the SELV-to-HV reinforced barrier must carry a reinforced rating with working voltage >= 440 VDC (or the barrier must be re-partitioned); verify the RxxP2xxyyD datasheet or select another part.

checked_items.item: Bergquist Sil-Pad 2000 dielectric breakdown and thermal values
checked_items.evidence: Bergquist datasheet PDS_SP_2000_0410 values reproduced in search summary and distributor pages (https://www.electronicsdatasheets.com/download/4998.pdf, https://ie.farnell.com/bergquist/2015-54/silicone-pad-3-5w-m-k-0-38mm/dp/681118): dielectric breakdown 4000 Vac (ASTM D149), thermal conductivity 3.5 W/m-K (ASTM D5470), thermal impedance 0.38 C-in2/W at 50 psi (0.57 at 10 psi), TO-220 2.02 C/W at 50 psi. Caveat: comparing a 4000 Vac breakdown value with a 4 kV 1.2/50 us impulse level is not like-for-like; the pad's acceptance must be stated as the standard's impulse or equivalent AC test, not as 'breakdown >= impulse'.

checked_items.item: IEC 60664-1 Table F.1 / 61800-5-1 Table 7 impulse voltages (300 V: OVC II 2500, III 4000; 600 V: OVC II 4000, III 6000)
checked_items.evidence: Secondary reproductions: MEAN WELL/Telerex OVC paper (https://kivi.nl/_Resources/Persistent/c/1/4/2/c142828297cac23640aabcdcce6d266e28eb4ef8/MEAN-WELL-POWER-FORUM-TELEREX-OVC-III-20180614-rev-1.1-FINAL.pdf) lists 1500/2500/4000/6000 V for 300 V and 2500/4000/6000/8000 V for 600 V across OVC I-IV; RECOM/eepower articles confirm the 1.2/50 us basis and 'reinforced takes the next higher level'. Standard text itself not accessed.

No accessible reproduction found in three searches; VDE corrigendum listing only confirms that 61800-5-1 Table 9 impulse clearances are derived from IEC 60664-1:2020 Table F.2; TI SLUAAR5 worked example (8 kV impulse -> 14 mm for reinforced) is consistent with a 12 kV->14 mm step but does not confirm the rows the agent used. Values are not contradicted by anything found, but could not be verified against the standard.

checked_items.item: IEC 60664-1 Table F.4 / 61800-5-1 Table 10 creepage rows (PWB PD2: 200 V 0.63, 250 1.0, 320 1.6, 400 2.0, 500 2.5, 630 3.2 mm; other insulators PD2 IIIa: 2.0/2.5/3.2/4.0/5.0/6.3 mm; interpolation permitted)

checked_items.item: IPC-2221B Table 6-1 functional spacing (301-500 V: B1 0.25, B2 2.5, B4 0.8 mm; >500 V slopes 0.0025 / 0.005 / 0.00305 mm per V)
checked_items.evidence: Secondary reproductions: https://pcbsync.com/ipc-2221/ (row values and all three slopes), https://help.altair.com/pollex/topics/pollex/verification/dfe_ipc_material_r.htm and https://blogs.sw.siemens.com/electronic-systems-design/?p=11251 (B1 at 600 V = 0.25 + 100 x 0.0025 = 0.50 mm). One secondary page gives 0.005 mm/V for the coated column - B4 slope to be confirmed in the standard. Siemens notes the current revision is IPC-2221C (Dec 2023); Table 6-1 is a functional-insulation table, not a safety table (pcbsync), as the agent uses it.

checked_items.item: IPC-2221 current-capacity formula I = k dT^0.44 A^0.725, k = 0.048 external / 0.024 internal, A in mil^2
checked_items.evidence: Multiple secondary sources (https://www.nextpcb.com/blog/pcb-trace-width-calculator-ipc-2221-guide, https://blog.mbedded.ninja/pcb-design/how-to-calculate-maximum-track-current/, https://www.protoexpress.com/blog/how-to-optimize-your-pcb-trace-using-ipc-2152-standard/) give the same formula and constants, note the data range (0-35 A, <= 3 oz, 10-100 C rise) and that IPC-2152 supersedes it and typically allows 1.5-2x the current - consistent with the agent's 'conservative basis' statement.

checked_items.item: Knowledge citations KR-ISO-001/002/003/004, KR-SN-001, KR-PR-001, KR-SN-005, KR-TH-002, KR-PCB-006, KR-GD-007, KR-GD-009 (existence, applicability, exclusions, verification method, no instance value copied)

knowledge_misuse: KR-TH-002 is cited as the basis for 'rated insulating pads (>= 4 kV AC breakdown)'; the rule contains no numeric limit (verification: human-review of 'interface voltage rating, creepage at the package edge and thermal resistance'). The 4 kV figure is the agent's own derivation and compares an AC breakdown value with an impulse withstand level; it should be marked 'adapted' and restated as the standard's impulse / equivalent-AC test requirement.

CMP-R12P21503D / KR-SN-001: the agent reported the module's reinforced working-voltage rating as 'not found', but the cached RECOM RxxP2xx series datasheet (REV 9-2024) states 'working voltage 250VACrms' and 'Insulation Grade according to 62368-1: basic'. Available evidence pointing to non-compliance with the 440 VDC reinforced barrier was not surfaced; the knowledge record itself omits these lines.

Verification tag [V] ('read from the text of EN 61800-5-1:2007') is applied to Tables 3, 7, 9, 10 and clauses 4.3.11 / 6.5.2, yet no copy of the standard exists in the repository knowledge base and none could be accessed by the verifier; the tag overstates the evidence level unless the consulted copy is identified.

No reference-instance value was copied as a design value (CGD15SG00D2 8 mm creepage, 800 Vpk and Tg >= 170 C used as cross-check only; CGD1700HB2M-UNA distances never extracted). The 1.0 mm non-plated slot width coincides with the CGD15SG00D2 instance but is justified independently as a fabrication minimum - acceptable, note only.
required_changes: Bias-module barrier (blocking): per the RECOM RxxP2xx series datasheet REV 9-2024 the family is 'Insulation Grade according to 62368-1: basic' with 'working voltage 250VACrms'. Remove R12P21503D (and, until proven otherwise, the Murata MGJ2 whose datasheet could not be fetched) from the list of parts that may bridge the SELV-to-HV reinforced barrier at 440 VDC, or obtain the RxxP2xxyyD variant datasheet and show a reinforced rating with working voltage >= 440 VDC; otherwise require a module certified for reinforced insulation at >= 440 VDC working voltage (or re-partition the barrier so the module only needs basic insulation). Raise this from 'human review' to a blocking open issue for the bias-supply agent.
Edition reference: replace 'The 2023 edition of IEC 61800-5-1' with 'IEC 61800-5-1:2022 (Ed. 3.0) + COR1:2023 (+ COR2:2025)'.

Reinforced-clearance TOV case: either show the interpolation arithmetic and the exact Table 9 rows that yield 6.4 mm or delete the figure; the agent's own quoted rows give about 5.8 mm (recurring-peak column) or 3.1 mm (impulse column). Design rule unaffected (9.0 mm governs).

Fuse: cite Littelfuse's product-page ratings (100 kA @ 600 VAC, 50 kA @ 600 VDC); remove or source the '10 kA DC (UL 248-19)' figure; obtain the KLKD datasheet melting I2t before claiming the fuse protects the board copper, connectors and capacitors.

Evidence tags: downgrade the 61800-5-1 Table 3/7/9/10 values and the 4.3.11 / 6.5.2 discharge and marking clauses from [V] to [S]/[U] unless the consulted copy of EN 61800-5-1:2007 is identified and placed on record; the only standards values independently corroborated in this run are the Table F.1 impulse series, IPC-2221B Table 6-1 and the IPC-2221 current formula.

TMCS1133: record that the TI product-page parametric table shows VIOWM 600 Vrms / 8.1 mm while SBOSAG0E states 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC reinforced and >= 8 mm; datasheet governs, but the sensing agent must confirm with TI before relying on the reinforced rating at 440 VDC.

Insulating pad: restate the KR-TH-002 requirement as the standard's test for basic insulation at the 4 kV impulse level (impulse or equivalent AC test voltage from 61800-5-1), not as 'AC breakdown >= 4 kV'; mark the 4 kV figure as the agent's derivation ('adapted'), and confirm the TO-247 die-cut Sil-Pad 2000 part number and thickness with Henkel.
summary: Primary-source check of the standards/insulation area. The three TI barrier parts are fully verified against the fetched datasheets (UCC21710-Q1 SLUSDH8D: 5.7 kVrms, 1500 Vrms / 2121 VDC, >8 mm, 150 V/ns, ACTIVE; AMC1311 SBAS786C: 7000 Vpk reinforced, 1500 Vrms / 2120 VDC, >= 8.5 mm, AMC1311B 100 kV/us; TMCS1133 SBOSAG0E: 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC reinforced, >= 8 mm, 100 ns, orderables ...AQDVGR, ACTIVE). The fuse, bleeder resistor, Y2 capacitor and Sil-Pad values are confirmed at manufacturer/distributor level with the limits the agent already declared (KLKD I2t and the 10 kA DC figure not found; Littelfuse shows 50 kA DC). All sixteen calculations reproduce except the non-reconstructible 6.4 mm TOV clearance. All cited knowledge records exist and were read correctly, with no reference-instance value adopted as a design value. Two corrections matter: (1) the RECOM RxxP2xx series datasheet states basic insulation grade and 250 VACrms working voltage, so the R12P2 bias module cannot be assumed to satisfy the 440 VDC reinforced barrier (the agent only wrote 'not found'); (2) '2023 edition' should be IEC 61800-5-1:2022 + COR1:2023. The numeric IEC 61800-5-1 / 60664-1 table values (clearance, creepage, DVC, discharge clause) could not be verified from any accessible text in this run and remain unverified despite the agent's [V] tag; only Table F.1, IPC-2221B Table 6-1 and the IPC-2221 formula were corroborated by secondary sources. Verdict: confirmed with corrections; the derived 9.0 mm / 5.0 mm / 3.0 mm DRC rules are conservative relative to every value found and are not contradicted.
